 UNION ALL (SELECT m.id,m.day FROM statarena_app.matches m WHERE m.season=$1 AND m.league_id=$2 
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM statarena_app.fixtures f WHERE f.id=m.id AND f.season=m.season AND f.league_id=m.league_id)
 ORDER BY m.day NULLS LAST,m.id LIMIT ($3::int+1))),

 SELECT a.*,p.name,p.image_url,s.value_text AS shirt_number_raw,s.value_type AS shirt_number_type
 FROM statarena_app.appearances a JOIN statarena_app.players p ON p.id=a.player_ref
 LEFT JOIN statarena_app.appearance_shirt_numbers s ON s.appearance_id=a.id
 WHERE a.match_id IN(SELECT id FROM page)),
 appearance_extras AS (
 SELECT e.appearance_id,json_object_agg(e.metric_key,e.value ORDER BY e.metric_key) extras
 FROM statarena_app.appearance_metrics e JOIN page_appearances a ON a.id=e.appearance_id GROUP BY e.appearance_id)

  FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute
  WHERE attrelid='statarena_app.appearances'::regclass AND attnum>0 AND NOT attisdropped
) THEN json_build_array(r.id,r.player_ref,r.ordinal,r.position_id_type,r.player_id,r.team_id,r.team,r.match_id,r.league_id,r.league,r.country,r.season,r.date,r.role,r.position_id,r.raw_pitch_x,r.raw_pitch_y,r.shirt_number,r.minutes,r.rating,r.goals,r.assists,r.xg,r.npxg,r.xa,r.xgot,r.shots,r.shots_on_target,r.chances_created,r.big_chances_created,r.passes_accurate,r.defensive_actions,r.interceptions,r.tackles,r.recoveries,r.duels_won,r.duels_lost,r.touches,r.touches_box,r.passes_final_third,r.clearances,r.blocks,r.dribbles,r.saves,r.goals_prevented,r.shots_off_target,r.blocked_shots,r.shots_woodwork,r.shot_accuracy,r.big_chances_missed,r.xg_plus_xa,r.long_balls_accurate,r.line_breaking_passes,r.accurate_crosses,r.corners,r.throws,r.offsides,r.dispossessed,r.dribbled_past,r.headed_clearances,r.aerials_won,r.ground_duels_won,r.fouls,r.was_fouled,r.errors_led_to_goal,r.goals_conceded,r.saves_inside_box,r.dive_saves,r.sweeper_actions,r.high_claims,r.punches,r.xgot_faced,r.distance_covered,r.top_speed,r.sprints,r.running_distance,r.sprinting_distance,r.fantasy_points,r.passes_attempted,r.long_balls_attempted,r.crosses_attempted,r.ground_duels,r.aerial_duels,r.dribbles_attempted,r.starter,r.stats_reliable,r.is_captain,r.name,r.image_url,r.extras,r.shirt_number_raw,r.shirt_number_type)

 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM statarena_app.team_statistics WHERE match_id IN(SELECT id FROM page) ORDER BY match_id,ordinal) r) stats,

 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT c.*,s.season,s.sample_matches,(SELECT json_agg(native_season ORDER BY ordinal) FROM statarena_app.competition_catalog_seasons k WHERE k.competition_id=c.id) catalog_seasons FROM statarena_app.competitions c JOIN statarena_app.competition_seasons s ON s.competition_id=c.id WHERE c.id=$2 AND s.season=$1) r) competitions,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT s.team_id AS id,s.name,s.image_url,s.sample_matches,t.country FROM statarena_app.team_seasons s JOIN statarena_app.teams t ON s.team_id=t.id WHERE season=$1 AND league_id=$2 ORDER BY s.team_id) r) teams,

SELECT idx.source_digest || refs.source_digest || coalesce(vals.digest,'') AS version,
    vals.pending ,jsonb_build_object('rows',
    CASE WHEN link.metric_label IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE vals.rows END) AS body
  FROM statarena_app.catalog_editions idx
  JOIN statarena_app.catalog_editions refs ON refs.catalog='club-links' AND refs.scope='' AND refs.edition=''
  LEFT JOIN statarena_app.cat_club_links_links link ON link.resource_id=refs.resource_id AND link.metric_label=$1
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT string_agg(c.source_digest,'' ORDER BY i.position) AS digest,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE c.resource_id IS NULL)::int AS pending
        ,coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'edition',statarena_app.read_cat_ranking_index_editions(i)-'path',
        'row',CASE WHEN r.record_no IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE statarena_app.read_cat_ranking_uefa_clubs_rows(r) END)
